meta.name: agenthub
meta.description: Multi-agent collaboration plugin that spawns N parallel subagents competing on the same task via git worktree isolation. Agents work independently, results are evaluated by metric or LLM judge, and the best branch is merged. Use when: user wants multiple approaches tried in parallel — code optimization, content variation, research exploration, or any task that benefits from parallel competition. Requires: a git repo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行运行多个子代理竞争同一任务，自动合并最优结果
copy.tagline_en: Run multiple subagents in parallel on the same task and auto-merge the best result
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multiple approaches tried in parallel and the best one automatically merged

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以同时启动多个独立 AI 子代理，每个代理在隔离的 git 工作区中并行尝试不同方案完成任务。最后自动评估结果，合并最优方案。
howto.when: 当你需要并行尝试多种方法时触发，例如代码优化、内容变体、研究探索等。前提是当前项目是一个 git 仓库。

say.text: 帮我并行优化这段代码，启动 3 个代理尝试不同算法。
say.note: 会触发 /hub:spawn 启动 3 个代理

say.text: 让代理们比赛写测试，覆盖率达到最高者胜出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can spawn multiple independent AI subagents that work in parallel on the same task, each in an isolated git worktree. Results are evaluated and the best branch is merged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to try multiple approaches in parallel, such as code optimization, content variation, or research exploration. Requires a git repository.

say_en.text: Help me optimize this code in parallel, spawn 3 agents trying different algorithms.
Have agents compete to write tests, the one with highest coverage wins.
